folds.heading: ## Cross-lane content reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B20)
folds.body: The opening deferral records the historical wave, not a standing current AD43 exemption. The source review repairs in native qualification, UI, personal return and completion preflight remain resolved at their original source snapshots; they do not close the five receiver families here. Keep the important interactions together: actual office rights do not transfer body/debt/mastery; a received report is knowledge rather than an inferred meeting; paid same-body/full-cargo passage differs from observation; a personal revisit does not enroll a new contract or refill old means; completion uses current actor/source/support before durable publication. Select relevant existing cases against current owners under AD36/AD43 rather than restarting every old schema or source lane. AD42 leaves human presentation/fiction feedback optional and distinct from agent verification. No native journey or source-world parity was proved by this reconciliation.
